limit.scope: A lead, not a finding: scoped to actions created while IAction::isRemote is set, which the b9246 mode writers place only in Remote-skin (Remote-client callback) and skin-load contexts.
limit.binary_shows: On b9246, IAction::create tests isRemote at 0x100596f45. When it is set, a fixed list of checked heads (deck, zone, skin_panel, get_time, zoom, get_var, set, toggle, get_text and others) either rejoins ordinary parsing at 0x1005974cf or reaches a source-text wrapper route at 0x100598365. Immediate-byte writes to the flag were verified in CSkinEngine::load, the CSkinScratch constructor and CVDJRemoteClient callbacks.
limit.why_not_testable_now: No fixture establishes isRemote independently. HTTP has not been shown to create actions with the flag set and is not a substitute for the fixture, a Remote-protocol subscription has not been shown to set it, and the flag is located by name only on b9246.
limit.unblock: A parser_remote_mode fixture: a verified way to create actions with isRemote set (a Remote-skin or skin-load context with a readback), an independent check that the flag is set, and a restoration procedure; then paired local and remote runs of the checked heads against nonsense controls.
limit.affects: If the lead holds, script in Remote skins and script evaluated during skin load. The existing HTTP captures are not evidence either way for those contexts.

limit.no_direct_reference: No direct reference does not prove dead code: an indirect call, computed target or inlined copy would not appear in that scan.
limit.why_not_testable_now: No consumer is known, so there is no verb to build a fixture around, and a live sweep could not attribute any reading to this helper.
limit.unblock: Resolve reachability first: an indirect-call or vtable inventory, or a runtime breakpoint on a build where the helper can be located, that names a consumer. Then a fixture contrasting missing, integer and text arguments in that consumer against nonsense controls.
limit.affects: Unknown until a consumer is named. Any verb whose argument selects from a value list could route through it.

limit.binary_shows: On b9246 the Button Editor has its own tree builder: getCurrentWord scans token-character ranges, updateList builds list entries and updateHint produces the hint. The selected builder does not call IAction::create. This is a structural contrast, not proof that the editor accepts a different language.
limit.why_not_testable_now: Not yet run, no longer blocked. Token spans and guard hints are visible only on screen, and the dialog exposes no script field or spans to accessibility, so every observation is a screenshot. The one coordinate calibration clicked through a cropped dialog onto a cue pad and started deck 1, whose prior position could not be restored; that click was meant to place the text cursor, which the 2026-09-19 reassessment shows was never needed. The help-display captures do not measure spans or guards.
limit.coordinate_clicking: Banned. Do not repeat the coordinate method recorded in tests/runtime-grammar-editor-spans-calibration-aborted-9598.json.
limit.unblock: A pointer-free chain, none of whose steps needs targeting: open the editor with custom_button_edit over HTTP execute (fallback: a keyboard shortcut mapped to the same verb); the script text is already focused when the dialog opens; select all and type the editor_corpus script; move the caret with arrow keys, Home and End, since getCurrentWord follows the caret; screenshot and read the token colouring; restore the original action by keyboard and verify by reopening, as the help-display runs did. Hover-based guard hints need a pointer move but no click. Before any keystroke: capture playback and position baselines for every deck, bring VirtualDJ to the front, and confirm through accessibility that the dialog exists. Save a screenshot for every editor_corpus observation.
limit.affects: Authors who judge a script by the Button Editor colouring or hints. Runtime rules are unaffected, and editor appearance is not evidence of runtime acceptance.

groups.structural_interpretation: actionGetText creates nested actions, sets source and calls queryText. matchStringWithFlag scans flag-prefix bytes before a length-bounded comparison and updates the input pointer on success. Existing text-reader evidence does not partition the whole formatter.
groups.next_action: Prioritize the preserved text-formatting failures and distinguish formatter flags from VDJScript grammar using literal/nested controls. Follow exact actionGetText call sites; do not expand every formatting branch by default.

groups.structural_interpretation: queryValue, queryBool and queryText call query and convert its typed result. paramToString has formatting calls distinct from queryText. toFloat dispatches on type tags and either reads float storage, converts integer storage or returns its initialized zero.

groups.next_action: Use explicit source/controller context and independently observed deck/state outcomes. Keep deferred execution, virtual targets and child propagation unresolved until their exact routes are measured.

family_fold_in.rule: Each review-with-existing-family symbol is listed under related_symbols on every obligation its group names. That listing is navigation for a later caller join; it adds no evidence link and does not map the symbol to the family. support-only symbols carry a one-line out_of_scope reason. context-fixture-needed, editor-fixture-needed and consumer-specific groups remain open items.
